title: Trump Floats $5,000 ‘Trump Dividend’ Checks if Republicans Win the Midterms
summary: In his convention speech, the president floated a $5,000 “Trump Dividend” for every adult American if Republicans keep control of Congress. The idea, like many others, may not come to pass.
